attacks.name: Doubleslap
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Egg Toss
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. If either of them is tails, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: It holds its egg carefully when moving so as not to break it. Still, it is fast enough to disappear in the blink of an eye.
cards.name: Chansey

attacks.name: Clamping Jaw
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn. If the Defending Pokémon tries to attack during your opponent's next turn, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack does nothing. (Benching either Pokémon ends this effect.)

cards.flavorText: It has 49 teeth in its mouth that are constantly replacing themselves. Pull one out, and a new one grows in.
cards.name: Dark Croconaw

attacks.name: Triple Headbutt
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: MAX Burst
attacks.text: Flip a number of coins equal to the number of Energy cards attached to your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

cards.flavorText: If one of its heads falls off, it turns into an Exeggcute, which begins to look for other Exeggcutes using a special form of telepathy.
cards.name: Dark Exeggutor

attacks.name: High Voltage
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent can't play Trainer cards during his or her next turn.

attacks.name: Stun Wave
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon has a Pokémon Power, that power stops working until the end of your next turn.

cards.flavorText: As a result of storing massive amounts of electricity there, it can no longer grow wool on certain areas of its body.
cards.name: Dark Flaaffy

attacks.name: Armor Up
attacks.text: Until the end of your next turn, if Dark Forretress would be Knocked Out by damage from an attack, flip a coin. If heads, Dark Forretress is not Knocked Out and its remaining HP become 10 instead.

attacks.name: Explosion
attacks.text: Dark Forretress does 60 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: It stays motionless in trees, driving away with flying armored shards from its hard shell any who come close.
cards.name: Dark Forretress

attacks.name: Call Back
attacks.text: Put a Baby Pokémon or Basic Pokémon card from your opponent's discard pile onto his or her Bench. Put 1 damage counter on that Pokémon. (You can't use this attack if your Bench is full.)

attacks.name: Surround
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep. If tails, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: It silently hunts its prey in dark rooms.
cards.name: Dark Haunter

attacks.name: Water Cannon
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 10 damage for each Water Energy card attached to Dark Omanyte. Don't apply Weakness and Resistance. You can't do more than 30 damage in this way.

cards.flavorText: This ancient Pokémon possessed 10 tentacles, which it used to swim through the ocean.
cards.name: Dark Omanyte

attacks.name: Rock Tackle
attacks.text: Dark Pupitar does 10 damage to itself. Dark Pupitar can't use this attack during your next turn.

attacks.name: Explosive Evolution
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon. Don't apply Weakness and Resistance. Then, search your deck for an Evolution card named Dark Tyranitar and put it on Dark Pupitar. (This counts as evolving Dark Pupitar.) Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.flavorText: It is encased within a hard shell, yet retains a great deal of mobility—a dangerous combination.
cards.name: Dark Pupitar

attacks.name: Incinerate
attacks.text: Show the top card of your opponent's deck to all players. If it's a Trainer card, discard it.

attacks.name: Rushing Magma
attacks.text: Discard the top 5 cards of your deck. (If there are fewer than 5 cards in your deck, discard all of them.) This attack does 20 damage for each Fire Energy card you discarded in this way.

cards.flavorText: If it turns its back to an opponent, it is a sign that it is getting ready to attack.
cards.name: Dark Quilava

attacks.name: Dark Song
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep. If tails, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Slap Awake
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon is Asleep or Confused, this attack does 20 damage plus 20 more damage. Then, the Defending Pokémon is no longer Asleep or Confused.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon has soft, fine hair. When angered, it increases in size and has been known to charge those it considers a threat.
cards.name: Dark Wigglytuff

attacks.name: Charging Horn
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 damage plus 30 more damage. If tails, this attack does 30 damage.

cards.flavorText: It is normally peaceful, but will attack any who get between it and honey, its favorite food.
cards.name: Heracross

attacks.name: One-Two Kick
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Heel Drop
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: It has a perfect sense of balance and can lash out with powerful kicks from any position.
cards.name: Hitmonlee

attacks.name: Corner
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Lunge
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: When night falls, the air fills with the eerie cries of this Pokémon as it stakes out its territory.
cards.name: Houndour

attacks.name: Expand
attacks.text: All damage done to Jigglypuff during your opponent's next turn is reduced by 10 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: If puffs its body up like a balloon and sings a lullaby that makes all who hear it fall into a deep sleep.
cards.name: Jigglypuff

attacks.name: Freezing Breath
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed. If tails, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Ice Pillar
attacks.text: Until the end of your opponent's next turn, as long as Light Dewgong is your Active Pokémon, prevent all damage done by attacks to your Benched Pokémon. (Any other effects of attacks still happen.)

cards.flavorText: It has an aerodynamic shape that allows it to swim at great speeds. The colder the water gets, the more active it becomes.
cards.name: Light Dewgong

attacks.name: Warm Up
attacks.text: If you have any benched Pokémon, search your deck for a Fire Energy card and attach it to 1 of them. Then shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Burning Flame
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. For each heads, discard a Fire Energy card attached to Light Flareon or this attack does nothing. This attack does 30 damage plus 20 damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: It creates its flames by swallowing air into a special pouch within its body, then heating it to over 3000 degrees.
cards.name: Light Flareon

attacks.name: Flipper Stroke
attacks.text: Your opponent looks at the top 3 cards of his or her deck. If any of them are basic Energy cards, he or she may show any number of them to you and put them into his or her hand. You do the same. Either way, each player shuffles his or her deck.

attacks.name: Core Blast
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage plus 20 more damage for each Special Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: The faster it swims, the brighter the glow on its forehead becomes.
cards.name: Light Golduck

attacks.name: Pulse Guard
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, whenever 30 or more damage is done to Light Jolteon (after applying Weakness and Resistance), prevent that damage. (Any other effects of attacks still happen.)

attacks.name: Thunder Needle
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads. If you get 2 or more heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: It can collect the ambient electrical energy in its cells and expel it in massive bursts.
cards.name: Light Jolteon

attacks.name: Return Home
attacks.text: If you have any Benched Pokémon, shuffle 1 of them and all cards attached to it into your deck.

attacks.name: Gentle Kick
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon has no damage counters on it, this attack does 40 damage. If it has any, this attack does 20 damage.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon never gets tired, no matter what it does or how hard it works.
cards.name: Light Machoke

attacks.name: Guiding Flame
attacks.text: Put a Baby Pokémon or a Basic Pokémon card from your discard pile onto your Bench. (You can't use this attack if your Bench is full.)

attacks.name: Fire Blast
attacks.text: Discard a Fire Energy card attached to Light Ninetales in order to use this attack.

cards.flavorText: It is said that each of its nine tails contains a different magical power.
cards.name: Light Ninetales

attacks.name: Fish Out
attacks.text: Your opponent may choose up to 3 Baby Pokémon, Basic Pokémon, and/or Evolution cards from his or her discard pile and shuffle them into his or her deck. Either way, you may do the same.

attacks.name: Splash About
attacks.text: If there are more Energy attached to the Defending Pokémon than to Light Slowbro, this attack does 20 damage plus 20 more damage. If not, this attack does 20 damage.

cards.flavorText: If the Shellder attached to its tail becomes separated, this Pokémon reverts to a normal Slowpoke.
cards.name: Light Slowbro

attacks.name: Wash Away
attacks.text: If you have any Benched Pokémon, flip a coin. If heads, remove all damage counters from 1 of your Benched Pokémon and discard all Energy cards attached to it.

attacks.name: Hypnoshower
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep. Remove 1 damage counter from each Benched Pokémon (yours and your opponent's) with any damage counters on it.

cards.flavorText: If its fins being to vibrate, it is a sign that it will begin raining soon.
cards.name: Light Vaporeon

attacks.name: Mysterious Wing
attacks.text: Your opponent may choose a Baby Pokémon, Basic Pokémon, or Evolution card from his or her discard pile and put it into his or her hand. Either way, you may do the same.

attacks.name: Synchronize
attacks.text: If Light Venomoth and the Defending Pokémon have a different number of Energy cards attached to them, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: It defends itself by flapping its wings at high speed, spreading poisonous powder throughout the air.
cards.name: Light Venomoth

attacks.name: Evolution Song
attacks.text: Your opponent may choose 1 of his or her Pokémon and search his or her deck for a card that evolves from that Pokémon. Your opponent attaches that card to that Pokémon. This counts as evolving that Pokémon. Either way, you may do the same, and then each player who searched shuffles his or her deck.

attacks.name: Body Slam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: If two of them brush against each other, they will not be able to separate themselves, as they enjoy touching each other's soft fur too much.
cards.name: Light Wigglytuff

attacks.name: Agility
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to Scyther.

cards.flavorText: It moves so fast as to be invisible to the naked eye. Even when standing still, its camouflage prevents it from being seen.
cards.name: Scyther

attacks.name: Charm
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon attacks during your opponent's next turn, any damage it does is reduced by 10 (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Spike Ball Tackle
attacks.text: Togepi does 10 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: Its shell is said to contain happiness itself, which it will share with those who are kind to it.
cards.name: Togepi

cards.flavorText: It is very meek and constantly crouches in a defensive posture. When threatened, it protects itself with the flame on its back.
cards.name: Cyndaquil

attacks.name: Ink Blast
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage plus 10 more damage for each Energy attached to Dark Octillery but not used to pay for this attack's Energy cost. You can't add more than 20 damage in this way.

attacks.name: Tentacle Wrap
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed. If tails, during your opponent's next turn, your opponent pays Colorless more to retreat the Defending Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It likes to sleep in rock caves and will even steal other Octillery's nests.
cards.name: Dark Octillery

attacks.name: Shed
attacks.text: Remove 1 damage counter from Dratini.

attacks.name: Fury Attack
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

cards.flavorText: Large from birth, this Pokémon increases in size throughout its life by regularly shedding its skin.
cards.name: Dratini

attacks.name: Sleep Powder
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Psyshock
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: Its shell is very durable, allowing it to survive even if the shell becomes cracked.
cards.name: Exeggcute

attacks.name: Nightmare
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: Its gas-like body allows it to enter almost anywhere, but it is vulnerable to high winds.
cards.name: Gastly

attacks.name: Tail Bite
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 20 more damage; if tails, this attack does 10 damage.

attacks.name: Psychic
attacks.text: Does 10 damage plus 10 more damage for each Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Its tail has a brain of its own, which can respond to stimuli such as scents. Many unsuspecting people have been bitten by it.
cards.name: Girafarig

attacks.name: Stun Poison
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed and Poisoned.

cards.flavorText: It spends its days hanging from cliffs, swooping down on any prey it spots from its high vantage point.
cards.name: Gligar

cards.flavorText: It fears nothing, not even opponents larger than itself.
cards.name: Growlithe

attacks.name: Dodge
attacks.text: If Hitmonchan would be damaged by an attack during your opponent's next turn, flip a coin. If heads, prevent that attack's damage done to Hitmonchan. (Any other effects of attacks still happen.)

cards.flavorText: Its punches are blindingly fast, but it can only fight for three minutes before tiring and needing to rest.
cards.name: Hitmonchan

attacks.name: Leer
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon can't attack during your opponent's next turn. (Benching or evolving either Pokémon ends this effect.)

cards.flavorText: It is born deep within the ground and has to burrow its way out.
cards.name: Larvitar

attacks.name: Swift
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness, Resistance, Pokémon Powers, or any other effects on the Defending Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Sensitive to cold, Ledyba gather in groups to share warmth when the temperature drops.
cards.name: Ledyba

attacks.name: Reflected Sunlight
attacks.text: Attach up to 2 Grass Energy cards from your hand to 1 of your Grass Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Although it is extremely active during the day, it stops moving entirely as soon as the sun sets.
cards.name: Light Sunflora

cards.flavorText: When bored, this super-strong Pokémon trains by lifting rocks.
cards.name: Machop

attacks.name: Giant Wave
attacks.text: Mantine can't attack during your next turn.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon is perfectly adapted to its ocean home. It can gather up enough speed to burst above the water like a whale.
cards.name: Mantine

cards.flavorText: Its soft wool coat captures air, allowing it to remain cool during the summer and warm in the winter.
cards.name: Mareep

attacks.name: Crushing Step
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 10 more damage; if tails, this attack does 10 damage.

cards.flavorText: It hits people with its nose as a sign of affection but doesn't know its own strength and so sometimes knocks people off their feet.
cards.name: Phanpy

cards.flavorText: It waits suspended from tree branches for insects to fly into its mouth, often not moving for hours at a time.
cards.name: Pineco

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon was created by human computer engineering. Its program is only capable of simple action and reaction.
cards.name: Porygon

attacks.name: Migraine
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused. If tails, Psyduck is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: Although possessed of great mental powers, it doesn't know how to use them.
cards.name: Psyduck

attacks.name: Fury Strikes
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

cards.flavorText: It can shoot a burst of water from its mouth to propel itself backward at high speeds, allowing it to flee from surprised enemies.
cards.name: Remoraid

attacks.name: Take Down
attacks.text: Seel does 10 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: Although clumsy on land, it moves easily through the arctic waters it calls home.
cards.name: Seel

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon is often seen crawling around in volcanic regions.
cards.name: Slugma

attacks.name: Sunbathe
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, remove all damage counters from Sunkern. Search your deck for a card that evolves from Sunkern and attach that card to Sunkern. This counts as evolving Sunkern. Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.flavorText: It is very small and powerless. If attacked, the best it can do is flap its leaves in an attempt to frighten away its enemies.
cards.name: Sunkern

attacks.name: Generate Cold
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: It moves with its sensitive nose pressed to the ground, always searching for food.
cards.name: Swinub

attacks.name: Water Gun
attacks.text: Does 10 damage plus 10 more damage for each Water Energy attached to Totodile but not used to pay for this attack's Energy cost. You can't add more than 20 damage in this way.

cards.flavorText: Its highly developed jaws are powerful enough to crush anything. Even experienced adult trainers must handle it with great caution.
cards.name: Totodile

attacks.name: Poisonpowder
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

cards.flavorText: It possesses a type of radar, which it can use to find the insects it eats for food, even in pitch darkness.
cards.name: Venonat

attacks.name: Ember
attacks.text: Discard 1 Fire Energy card attached to Vulpix in order to use this attack.

cards.flavorText: As it grows older, its white tail changes colors and splits into six different tails. Its body radiates a faint warmth.
cards.name: Vulpix
Broken Ground Gym
rules: This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play.
Each player pays Colorless more to retreat a Baby Pokémon or Basic Pokémon.

cards.name: EXP.ALL
rules: Attach EXP.ALL to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't have a Pokémon Tool attached to it.

During your opponent's turn, if your Active Pokémon would be Knocked Out by your opponent's attack, you may take 1 of the basic Energy cards attached to your Active Pokémon and attach it to the Pokémon with EXP.ALL attached to it. If you do, discard EXP.ALL.

cards.name: Impostor Professor Oak's Invention
rules: Look at your opponent's Prize cards. You may have your opponent shuffle them into his or her deck. If you do, your opponent takes that many cards from the top of his or her deck and sets them aside as his or her new Prize cards (without looking at them).

cards.name: Radio Tower
rules: This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play.
Once during each player's turn (before attacking), that player may look at the top 2 cards of his or her deck and put them back in the same order.

cards.name: Thought Wave Machine
rules: Flip a coin until you get tails. For each heads, return an Energy card attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon to your opponent's hand. If the Pokémon has fewer attached Energy cards than that, return all of them to your opponent's hand. Your turn is over now (you don't get to attack).

cards.name: Counterattack Claws
rules: Attach Counterattack Claws to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't have a Pokémon Tool attached to it.

During your opponent's turn, if the Pokémon Counterattack Claws is attached to is your Active Pokémon and an opponent's attack damages it (even if it is Knocked Out), flip a coin. If heads, put 2 damage counters on the Defending Pokémon. Then, discard Counterattack Claws.

cards.name: Energy Amplifier
rules: Choose an Energy card in your hand, show it to your opponent, and shuffle it into your deck. Then flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for up to 3 basic Energy cards. Show them to your opponent, and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.name: Energy Stadium
rules: This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play.
Once during each player's turn (before attacking), that player may flip a coin. If heads, that player puts a basic Energy card from his or her discard pile into his or her hand.

cards.name: Lucky Stadium
rules: This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play.
Once during each player's turn (before attacking), that player may flip a coin. If heads, that player draws a card.

cards.name: Magnifier
rules: Attach Magnifier to 1 of your Pokémon. At the end of your turn, discard Magnifier. If the Pokémon Magnifier is attached to attacks, don't apply Resistance for that attack.

cards.name: Pokémon Personality Test
rules: Put an Evolution card from your hand face down in front of you. Your opponent guesses whether it is a Pokémon card with Light in its name, a Pokémon card with Dark in its name, or neither one. Flip the card over. If your opponent guessed right, he or she draws 3 cards. If your opponent guessed wrong, you draw 3 cards. Either way, return the card to your hand.

cards.name: Team Rocket's Evil Deeds
rules: Look at your opponent's hand and choose a card there. Your opponent shuffles that card into his or her deck. Then, your opponent may draw up to 2 cards.

cards.name: Heal Powder
rules: Flip a coin. If heads, your Active Pokémon is no longer Asleep, Confused, Paralyzed, or Poisoned and remove 2 damage counters from it. If your Active Pokémon has fewer damage counters than that, remove all of them.

cards.name: Mail from Bill
rules: You can't play this card if you have 5 or more cards in your hand (including this one). Draw cards until you have exactly 4 cards in your hand.

attacks.name: Healing Water
attacks.text: Remove a number of damage counters from 1 of your Benched Pokémon equal to the number of Water Energy cards attached to Shining Celebi. If the Pokémon has fewer damage counters than that, remove all of them.

attacks.name: Miracle Leaf
attacks.text: Flip a number of coins equal to the number of Energy attached to the Defending Pokémon. If you get 1 or more heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep, Confused, or Poisoned (your choice).

cards.flavorText: It is worshipped as a god of the forest. It appears only in undisturbed old-growth forests.
cards.name: Shining Celebi
rules: You can't have more than 1 Shining Celebi in your deck.

attacks.name: White-hot Flame
attacks.text: Discard 1 Fire Energy card and 1 Lightning Energy card attached to Shining Charizard or this attack does nothing. Flip a coin. If tails, Shining Charizard does 30 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: The flames it breathes are so hot that they can melt anything.
cards.name: Shining Charizard
rules: You can't have more than 1 Shining Charizard in your deck.

attacks.name: Lightning Cut
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 damage plus 10 more damage and does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) If tails, this attack does 30 damage and Shining Kabutops does 10 damage to itself.

attacks.name: Water Slash

rules: If you play this card from your hand, the Pokémon you attach it to is no longer affected by a Special Condition. Full Heal Energy provides Colorless energy. (Doesn't count as a basic Energy card.)

cards.name: Potion Energy
rules: If you play this card from your hand, remove 1 damage counter from the Pokémon you attach it to, if it has any. Potion Energy provides Colorless energy. (Doesn't count as a basic Energy card.)

cards.name: Pokémon Breeder
rules: Put a Stage 2 Evolution card from your hand on the matching Basic Pokémon. You can play this card only when you would be allowed to evolve that Pokémon anyway.

cards.name: Pokémon Trader
rules: Trade 1 of the Basic Pokémon or Evolution cards in your hand for 1 of the Basic Pokémon or Evolution cards from your deck. Show both cards to your opponent. Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.name: Scoop Up
rules: Choose 1 of your Pokémon in play and return its Basic Pokémon card to your hand. (Discard all cards attached to that card.)

cards.name: The Boss's Way
rules: Search your deck for an Evolution card with Dark in its name. Show it to your opponent and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.name: Challenge!
rules: Ask your opponent if he or she accepts your challenge. If your opponent declines (or if both Benches are full), draw 2 cards. If your opponent accepts, each of you searches your decks for any number of Basic Pokémon cards and puts them face down onto your Benches. (A player can't do this if his or her Bench is full.) When you both have finished, shuffle your decks and turn those cards face up.

cards.name: Energy Retrieval
rules: Trade 1 of the other cards in your hand for up to 2 basic Energy cards from your discard pile.

cards.name: Bill
rules: Draw 2 cards.

cards.name: Mysterious Fossil
rules: Play Mysterious Fossil as if it were a Basic Pokémon. While in play, Mysterious Fossil counts as a Pokémon (instead of a Trainer card). Mysterious Fossil has no attacks, can't retreat, and can't be affected by Special Conditions. If Mysterious Fossil is Knocked Out, it doesn't count as a Knocked Out Pokémon. (Discard it anyway.) At any time during your turn before your attack, you may discard Mysterious Fossil from play. You can put Pokémon that evolve from Mysterious Fossil on this card.

rules: Remove up to 2 damage counters from 1 of your Pokémon.

(Doesn't count as a basic Energy card when not in play.) When you attach this card from your hand to 1 of your Pokémon, put 1 damage counter on that Pokémon.

cards.name: Boost Energy
rules: Boost Energy can be attached only to an Evolved Pokémon. Discard Boost Energy at the end of the turn it was attached. Boost Energy provides ColorlessColorlessColorless Energy. The Pokémon Boost Energy is attached to can't retreat. When the Pokémon Boost Energy is attached to is no longer an Evolved Pokémon, discard Boost Energy.

cards.name: Crystal Energy
rules: Crystal Energy provides 1 Energy of all types (colors) of basic Energy cards attached to the Pokémon Crystal Energy is attached to. If there are no basic Energy cards attached to the Pokémon Crystal Energy is attached to, Crystal Energy provides Colorless Energy.

cards.name: Warp Energy
rules: Warp Energy provides 1 Colorless Energy. When you attach Warp Energy from your hand to your Active Pokémon, switch your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

abilities.name: Crystal Type
abilities.text: Whenever you attach a Water, Lightning, or Psychic basic Energy card from your hand to Kingdra, Kingdra's type (color) becomes the same as that Energy card type until the end of the turn.

attacks.name: Aquabomb
attacks.text: Kingdra does 10 damage to itself. (Don't apply Weakness or Resistance when Kingdra damages itself with this attack.)

attacks.name: Dual Burn
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. For each tails, discard 1 Energy card attached to Kingdra.

abilities.name: Crystal Type
abilities.text: Whenever you attach a Fire, Water, or Psychic basic Energy card from your hand to Lugia, Lugia's type (color) becomes the same as that Energy card type until the end of the turn.

attacks.name: Psychic
attacks.text: This attack does 10 damage times the number of Energy cards attached to the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Steam Blast
attacks.text: Discard an Energy card attached to Lugia.

abilities.name: Crystal Type
abilities.text: Whenever you attach a Grass, Lightning, or Fire basic Energy card from your hand to Nidoking, Nidoking's type (color) becomes the same as that Energy card type until the end of the turn.

attacks.name: Poison Horn
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

attacks.name: Rolling Thunder
attacks.text: Flip a coin, If heads, this attack does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. If tails, this attack does 10 damage to each of your Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness or Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Thundershock
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Reflect Energy
attacks.text: If you have any Benched Pokémon and if there are any basic Energy cards attached to Ampharos, take 1 of those Energy cards and attach it to 1 of those Pokémon.

abilities.name: Extreme Speed
abilities.text: You pay Colorless less to retreat Arcanine for each Energy attached to it.

attacks.name: Fire Blow
attacks.text: You may discard any number of Fire Energy cards attached to Arcanine when you use this attack. If you do, flip a number of coins equal to the number of Fire Energy cards you discarded. This attack does 30 damage plus 30 more damage for each heads.

abilities.name: Gluey Slime
abilities.text: As long as Ariados is in play, each player must pay an additional Colorless to retreat his or her Active Pokémon. Gluey Slime can't make a player pay more than an additional Colorless to retreat a Pokémon, even if there is more than 1 Ariados in play.

attacks.name: Spider Force
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 10 more damage. If tails, this attack does 20 damage and the defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

abilities.name: Bubble Turn
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if Azumarill is on your Bench, you may flip a coin. If heads, return Azumarill and all cards attached to it to your hand.

attacks.name: Aqua Sonic
attacks.text: Don't apply Resistance.

abilities.name: Flower Supplement
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may flip a coin. If heads, attach 1 basic Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Benched Pokémon. This power can't be used if Bellossom is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Knife Leaf
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

abilities.name: Happy Healing
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), choose 1 of your Benched Pokémon and flip a coin. If heads, count the number of Energy attached to Blissey and then remove that many damage counters from the chosen Benched Pokémon. This power can't be used if Blissey is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Smash Bomber
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

abilities.name: Super Dynamo
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if Electrode is your Active Pokémon, you may flip a coin. If heads, choose a Lightning Energy card from your discard pile and attach it to 1 of your Pokémon. This power can't be used if Electrode is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Swift
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness, Resistance, Poké-Powers, Poké-Bodies, or any other effects on the Defending Pokémon.

abilities.name: Pure Body

attacks.name: Burning Fang
attacks.text: You may flip a coin. If heads, discard a Fire Energy card attached to Entei and the Defending Pokémon is now Burned.

abilities.name: Energy Return

attacks.name: Damage Blast
attacks.text: Flip a number of coins equal to the number of damage counters on the Defending Pokémon. This attack does 30 damage plus 10 more damage for each heads.

attacks.name: Fireworks

attacks.name: Dark Impact

attacks.name: Spiral Aura

attacks.name: Cotton Punch
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 times the number of heads.

abilities.name: Water Cyclone

attacks.name: Rapids
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard 1 Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon, if any.

abilities.name: Ion Coating
abilities.text: You may use this power once during each of your turns (before your attack). All Lightning Energy attached to your Active Pokémon becomes Water Energy for the rest of the turn. (This effect ends if your Active Pokémon retreats or is returned to your hand.) This power can't be used if Lanturn is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Electric Tackle

abilities.name: Magnetic Flow
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if Magneton is your Active Pokémon, you may flip a coin. If heads, choose 2 of your opponent's Pokémon that have Energy cards attached to them. Choose 1 of the Energy cards attached to each of those Pokémon and switch them between the Pokémon. This power can't be used if Magneton is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Steel Wave

abilities.name: Poison Resistance

attacks.name: Snatch

(You must still do anything else required in order to use that attack.) (No matter what type the Defending Pokémon is, Togetic is still Colorless.) Togetic performs that attack.

Your opponent then draws the same number of cards from his or her deck. This power can't be used if Umbreon is affected by a Special Condition.

If you get 3 heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 50 more damage. If you get 4 heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 90 more damage.

abilities.name: Carry Off
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may flip a coin. If heads, look at your opponent's hand. If your opponent has any Baby Pokémon, Basic Pokémon, or Evolution cards there, choose 1 of them. Your opponent shuffles that card into his or her deck. This power can't be used if Crobat is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Burn Booster

cards.name: Team Galactic's Wager
rules: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

Each player shuffles his or her hand into his or her deck, and you and your opponent play "Rock-Paper-Scissors." The player who wins draws up to 6 cards. The player who loses draws up to 3 cards. (You draw your cards first.)

abilities.name: Armor Stone
abilities.text: Whenever Armor Fossil would be damaged by your opponent's attack, flip a coin until you get tails. For each heads, reduce that damage by 10.

cards.name: Armor Fossil
rules: Play Armor Fossil as if it were a Colorless Basic Pokémon. (Armor Fossil counts as a Trainer card as well, but if Armor Fossil is Knocked Out, this counts as a Knocked Out Pokémon.) Armor Fossil can't be affected by any Special Conditions and can't retreat. At any time during your turn before your attack, you may discard Armor Fossil from play. (This doesn't count as a Knocked Out Pokémon.)

abilities.name: Skull Stone
abilities.text: During your opponent's turn, if Skull Fossil would be Knocked Out by damage from an opponent's attack, flip a coin until you get tails. For each heads, put 1 damage counter on the Attacking Pokémon.

cards.name: Skull Fossil
rules: Play Skull Fossil as if it were a Colorless Basic Pokémon. (Skull Fossil counts as a Trainer card as well, but if Skull Fossil is Knocked Out, this counts as a Knocked Out Pokémon.) Skull Fossil can't be affected by any Special Conditions and can't retreat. At any time during your turn before your attack, you may discard Skull Fossil from play. (This doesn't count as a Knocked Out Pokémon.)

cards.name: Multi Energy
rules: Attach Multi Energy to 1 of your Pokémon. While in play, Multi Energy provides every type of Energy but provides only 1 Energy at a time. (Has no effect other than providing Energy.) Multi Energy provides Colorless Energy when attached to a Pokémon that already has Special Energy cards attached to it.

cards.name: Darkness Energy
rules: If the Pokémon Darkness Energy is attached to attacks, the attack does 10 more damage to the Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance). Ignore this effect if the Pokémon that Darkness Energy is attached to isn't Darkness. Darkness Energy provides Darkness Energy. (Doesn't count as a basic Energy card.)

cards.name: Metal Energy
rules: Damage done by attacks to the Pokémon that Metal Energy is attached to is reduced by 10 (after applying Weakness and Resistance). Ignore this effect if the Pokémon that Metal Energy is attached to isn't Metal. Metal Energy provides Metal Energy. (Doesn't count as a basic Energy card.)

abilities.name: Shocking Tail
abilities.text: As long as Electivire is your Active Pokémon, whenever your opponent attaches an Energy card from his or her hand to 1 of his or her Pokémon, put 2 damage counters on that Pokémon.

attacks.name: Pulse Barrier
attacks.text: Discard all of your opponent's Pokémon Tool cards and Stadium cards in play. If you do, prevent all effects, including damage, done to Electivire during your opponent's next turn.

cards.name: Electivire LV.X
rules: Put this card onto your Active Electivire. Electivire LV.X can use any attack, Poké-Power, or Poké-Body from its previous level.

abilities.name: Stance
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), when you put Lucario LV.X from your hand onto your Active Lucario, you may use this power. Prevent all effects of an attack, including damage, done to Lucario during your opponent's next turn. (If Lucario is no longer your Active Pokémon, this effect ends.)

attacks.name: Close Combat
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, any damage done to Lucario by attacks is increased by 30 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.name: Lucario LV.X
rules: Put this card onto your Active Lucario. Lucario LV.X can use any attack, Poké-Power, or Poké-Body from its previous level.

abilities.name: Torrid Wave
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if Magmortar is your Active Pokémon, you may choose 1 of the Defending Pokémon. That Pokémon is now Burned. Put 3 damage counters instead of 2 on that Pokémon between turns. This power can't be used if Magmortar is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Flame Bluster
attacks.text: Discard 2 Fire Energy attached to Magmortar. Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 100 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) During your next turn, Magmortar can't use Flame Bluster.

cards.name: Magmortar LV.X
rules: Put this card onto your Active Magmortar. Magmortar LV.X can use any attack, Poké-Power, or Poké-Body from its previous level.

cards.name: Time-Space Distortion
rules: Flip 3 coins. For each heads, search your discard pile for a Pokémon, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand.

abilities.name: Protective Wall
abilities.text: Prevent all damage done to your Benched Pokémon by your opponent's attacks.

attacks.name: Anger Revenge
attacks.text: If Bastiodon was damaged by an attack during your opponent's last turn, this attack does 40 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: Any frontal attack is repulsed. It is a docile Pokémon that feeds on grass and berries.
cards.name: Bastiodon

attacks.name: Feint
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.

attacks.name: Aura Sphere
attacks.text: Does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: It has the ability to sense the auras of all things. It understands human speech.
cards.name: Lucario

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon and put it onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Aqua Ring
attacks.text: Switch Manaphy with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Born on a cold seafloor, it will swim great distances to return to its birthplace.
cards.name: Manaphy

attacks.name: Minor Errand-Running
attacks.text: Search your deck for a basic Energy card, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Thunder Jolt
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, Pachirisu does 10 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: It makes fur balls that crackle with static electricity. It stores them with berries in tree holes.
cards.name: Pachirisu

attacks.name: Assurance
attacks.text: As long as the Defending Pokémon's remaining HP is 60 or less, this attack's base damage is 60 instead of 30.

attacks.name: Hasty Headbutt
attacks.text: Rampardos does 20 damage to itself. This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness, Resistance, Poké-Powers, Poké-Bodies, or any other effects on the Defending Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Its powerful head butt has enough power to shatter even the most durable things upon impact.
cards.name: Rampardos

attacks.name: Blowing Wind
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, put 1 of your Benched Pokémon and all cards attached to it on top of your deck. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Ominous Wind
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused and can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: A Pokémon formed by the spirits of people and Pokémon. It loves damp, humid seasons.
cards.name: Drifloon

attacks.name: Surprise Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

cards.name: Gible
rules: Oran Berry: Remove 1 damage counter from Gible at the end of your turn.

attacks.name: Wild Kick
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: The aura that emanates from its body intensifies to alert others if it is afraid or sad.
cards.name: Riolu

attacks.name: Spark
attacks.text: Does 10 damage to 2 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.name: Pikachu
rules: Oran Berry: Remove 1 damage counter from Pikachu at the end of your turn.

attacks.name: Whirlwind
attacks.text: Your opponent switches the Defending Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Clutch
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: It flies around forests and fields in search of bug Pokémon. It stays within a huge flock.
cards.name: Staravia

attacks.name: Amnesia
attacks.text: Choose 1 of the Defending Pokémon's attacks. That Pokémon can't use that attack during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Scavenge
attacks.text: Search your discard pile for a Trainer card, show it to your opponent, an put it into your hand.

cards.flavorText: With nerves of steel, nothing can perturb it. It is more agile and active than it appears.
cards.name: Bidoof

attacks.name: Jump Kick
attacks.text: Does 10 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: It slams foes by sharply uncoiling is rolled ears. It stings enough to make a grown-up cry in pain.
cards.name: Buneary

attacks.name: Sleep Powder
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Leech Seed
attacks.text: If this attack does any damage to the Defending Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance), remove 1 damage counter from Cherubi.

cards.flavorText: The small ball holds the nutrients needed for evolution. Apparently, it is very sweet and tasty.
cards.name: Cherubi

attacks.name: Ember
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads discard a Fire Energy attached to Chimchar.

cards.flavorText: It agilely scales cliffs to live atop craggy mountains. Its fire is put out when it sleeps.
cards.name: Chimchar

attacks.name: Water Spash
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 10 more damage.

cards.flavorText: Because it is very proud, it hates accepting food from people. Its thick down guards it from cold.
cards.name: Piplup

attacks.name: Quick Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 20 more damage.

cards.flavorText: They flock in great numbers. Though small, they flap their wings with great power.
cards.name: Starly

cards.flavorText: Made from soil, the shell on its back hardens when it drinks water. It lives along lakes.
cards.name: Turtwig

abilities.name: Jamming
abilities.text: After your opponent plays a Supporter card from his or her hand, put 1 damage counter on each of your opponent's Pokémon. You can't use more than 1 Jamming Poké-Body each turn.

attacks.name: Cluster Bolt
attacks.text: You may discard all Lightning Energy attached to Ampharos. If you do, this attack does 20 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon that has any Energy cards attached to it. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: The tip of its tail shines brightly. In the olden days, people sent signals using the tail's light.
cards.name: Ampharos

abilities.name: Waterlog
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may attach as many basic Water Energy cards from your hand to any of your Pokémon in any way you like. If you do, your turn ends. This power can't be used if Blastoise is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Hydro Pump
attacks.text: Does 50 damage plus 20 more damage for each Water Energy attached to Blastoise but not used to pay for this attack's Energy cost. You can't add more than 40 damage in this way.

cards.flavorText: The jets of water it spouts from the rocket cannons on its shell can punch through thick steel.
cards.name: Blastoise

abilities.name: Fury Blaze
abilities.text: If your opponent has 3 or less Prize cards left, each of Charizard's attacks does 50 more damage to the Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Blast Burn
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard 2 Energy cards attached to Charizard. If tails, discard 4 Energy cards attached to Charizard. (If you can't, this attack does nothing.)

cards.flavorText: It is said that CHARIZARD's fire burns hotter if it has experienced harsh battles.
cards.name: Charizard

abilities.name: Burning Coat
abilities.text: Whenever 1 of your opponent's Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from Entei's attacks, discard the top 3 cards from your opponent's deck.

attacks.name: Blaze Roar
attacks.text: Does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) Flip a coin. If tails, discard 2 Fire Energy attached to Entei.

cards.flavorText: It is said that when it roars, a volcano erupts somewhere around the globe.
cards.name: Entei

abilities.name: Irritating Buzz
abilities.text: As long as Flygon is your Active Pokémon, put 1 damage counter on each of your opponent's Active Pokémon between turns, excluding Fighting Pokémon.

attacks.name: Sand Sonic
attacks.text: If you attach a Fighting Energy card from your hand to Flygon during this turn, this attack does 60 damage plus 20 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It whips up sandstorms with powerful flaps of its wings. It is known as "The Desert Spirit."
cards.name: Flygon

attacks.name: Sonic Blade
attacks.text: Put damage counters on the Defending Pokémon until it is 50 HP away from being Knocked Out. If you do, your opponent switches the Defending Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Psychic Cut
attacks.text: You may choose as many of your face-down Prize cards as you like and put them face up. If you do, this attack does 60 damage plus 20 more damage for each Prize card you chose. (These cards remain face up for the rest of the game.)

cards.flavorText: A master of courtesy and swordsmanship, it fights using extending swords on its elbows.
cards.name: Gallade

abilities.name: Telepass
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may search your opponent's discard pile for a Supporter card and use the effect of that card as the effect of this power. (The Supporter card remains in your opponent's discard pile.) You can't use more than 1 Telepass Poké-Power each turn. This power can't be used if Gardevoir is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Psychic Lock
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, your opponent can't use any Poké-Powers on his or her Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It will try to guard its trusted Trainer with its life. It has the ability to see the future.
cards.name: Gardevoir

abilities.name: Osmotic Pressure
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if you have Gastrodon West Sea in play, you may move up to 3 damage counters from Gastrodon East Sea to 1 of your Gastrodon West Sea.

attacks.name: Dwindling Wave
attacks.text: Does 80 damage minus 10 damage for each damage counter on Gastrodon East Sea.

cards.flavorText: It has a pliable body without any bones. If any part of its body is torn off, it grows right back.
cards.name: Gastrodon East Sea

attacks.name: Raging Flood
attacks.text: Does 20 damage plus 10 more damage for each damage counter on Gastrodon West Sea. Then, remove 2 damage counters from Gastrodon West Sea.

attacks.name: Wild Waves
attacks.text: Put 1 damage counter on each Benched Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's).

cards.flavorText: It has a pliable body without any bones. If any part of its body is torn off, it grows right back.
cards.name: Gastrodon West Sea

abilities.name: Phoenix Turn
abilities.text: Once during your opponent's turn, if Ho-Oh would be Knocked Out by damage from an attack, you may flip a coin. If heads, Ho-Oh isn't discarded. Instead, remove all damage counters, Special Conditions, and other effects from Ho-Oh. Then, discard all cards attached to Ho-Oh (except for Energy cards). This counts as Ho-Oh being Knocked Out and your opponent takes a Prize card.

attacks.name: Rainbow Wing
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage times the number of different types of basic Energy cards attached to Ho-Oh.

cards.flavorText: Its feathers are in seven colors. It is said that anyone seeing it is promised eternal happiness.
cards.name: Ho-Oh

abilities.name: Cotton Spore
abilities.text: Whenever Jumpluff would be damaged by your opponent's attack, flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done to Jumpluff by that attack.

attacks.name: Cottonweed Punch
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. For each heads, this attack does 30 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: Blown by seasonal winds, it circles the globe, scattering cotton spores as it goes.
cards.name: Jumpluff

attacks.name: Tongue Reel
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. If you choose a Benched Pokémon, switch the Defending Pokémon with that Pokémon. This attack does 20 damage to the Pokémon you chose. Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Boundless Power
attacks.text: During your next turn, Lickilicky can't attack.

cards.flavorText: It wraps things with its extensible tongue. Getting to close to it will leave you soaked with drool.
cards.name: Lickilicky

abilities.name: Rain Dish
abilities.text: At any time between turns, remove 1 damage counter from Ludicolo.

attacks.name: Nature Power
attacks.text: If you have a Stadium Card in play, this attack does 60 damage plus 20 more damage. If your opponent has a Stadium card in play, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: If it hears festive music, all its muscles fill with energy. It can't help breaking out into a dance.
cards.name: Ludicolo

attacks.name: Silver Wing
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, choose an Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon and return it to your opponent's hand.

attacks.name: Psychic Destruction
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon has any Energy cards attached to it, this attack's base damage is 40 instead of 120.

cards.flavorText: It sleeps in a deep-sea trench. If it flaps its wings, it is said to cause a 40-day storm.
cards.name: Lugia

attacks.name: Psychic Balance
attacks.text: If you have less cards in your hand than your opponent, draw cards until you have the same number of cards as your opponent. (If you have more or the same number of cards in your hand as your opponent, this attack does nothing.)

attacks.name: Re-creation
attacks.text: Choose an attack on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon in his or her discard pile. Re-creation copies that attack except for its Energy cost. (You must still do anything else required for that attack.) Mew performs that attack.

cards.flavorText: Because it can use all kinds of moves, many scientists believe MEW to be the ancestor of Pokémon.
cards.name: Mew

abilities.name: Thunder Rumble
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), when you attach a Lightning Energy card from your hand to Raikou, you may put 1 damage counter on 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Thunder Climb
attacks.text: Discard 3 cards from the top of your deck. This attack does 50 damage plus 10 more damage for each Lightning Energy card you discarded. Then, attach those Lightning Energy cards to 1 of your Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It is said to have fallen with lightning. It can fire thunderbolts from the rain clouds on its back.
cards.name: Raikou

attacks.name: Sleep Poison
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep and Poisoned.

attacks.name: Magical Leaf
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 40 damage plus 30 more damage and remove 3 damage counters from Roserade.

cards.flavorText: It attracts prey with a sweet aroma, then downs it with thorny whips hidden in its arms.
cards.name: Roserade

attacks.name: Direct Hit
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness, Resistance, Poké-Powers, Poké-Bodies, or any other effects on the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Dragon Finish
attacks.text: Discard 2 basic Fire Energy cards or 2 basic Water Energy cards attached to Salamence. If you discarded 2 basic Fire Energy cards, this attack does 100 damage to the Defending Pokémon. If you discarded 2 Basic Water Energy cards, this attack does 100 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) (If you can't discard cards, this attack does nothing.)

cards.flavorText: As a result of its long-held dream of flying, its cellular structure changes, and wings grew out.
cards.name: Salamence

abilities.name: Aqua Recover
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you put Suicune from your hand onto your Bench, you may search your discard pile for up to 3 Water Pokémon, show them to your opponent, and put them into your hand.

attacks.name: Cure Stream
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, any damage done by attacks from the Defending Pokémon is reduced by 20 (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: It races around the world to purify fouled water. It dashes away with the north wind.
cards.name: Suicune

abilities.name: Miracle Aroma
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may flip a coin. If heads, choose either Asleep, Burned, or Poisoned. The Defending Pokémon is now affected by that Special Condition. This power can't be used if Venusaur is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Giant Bloom
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, remove 4 damage counters from Venusaur.

cards.flavorText: After a rainy day, the flower on its back smells stronger. The scent attracts other Pokémon.
cards.name: Venusaur

attacks.name: Baleful Wind
attacks.text: Choose a card from your opponent's hand without looking and discard it. If you discarded a Trainer, Supporter, or Stadium card, choose 1 more card from your opponent's hand without looking and discard it.

attacks.name: Raid
attacks.text: If you played Absol from your hand during this turn, this attack's base damage is 40 instead of 10.

cards.flavorText: It senses disasters coming and appears before people only to warn them of impending danger.
cards.name: Absol

abilities.name: Flame Dash
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you play Arcanine from your hand to evolve 1 of your Benched Pokémon, you may switch Arcanine with 1 of your Active Pokémon. If you do, you may move any number of Energy cards attached to that Pokémon to Arcanine.

attacks.name: Inferno Onrush
attacks.text: Arcanine does 40 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: Its proud and regal appearance has captured the hearts of people since long ago.
cards.name: Arcanine

attacks.name: Ghost Head
attacks.text: Put as many damage counters as you like on Banette. (You can't put more than Banette's remaining HP.) Put that many damage counters on the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Spiteful Pain
attacks.text: If Banette is in your discard pile, this attack does 40 damage plus 40 more damage, then search your discard pile for Banette, show it to your opponent, and shuffle it into your deck.

cards.flavorText: A doll that became a Pokémon over its grudge from being junked. It seeks the child that disowned it.
cards.name: Banette

attacks.name: Dig Trap
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing. If heads, prevent all effects of an attack, including damage, done to Dugtrio during your opponent's next turn. If Dugtrio is your Active Pokémon at the end of your opponent's next turn, put 6 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Pit Trap
attacks.text: Your opponent flips a coin. If tails, this attack does 50 damage plus 50 more damage.

cards.flavorText: Its three heads moves alternately, driving it through tough soil to depths of over 60 miles.
cards.name: Dugtrio

abilities.name: Motor Drive
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may search your discard pile for a Lightning Energy card and attach it to Electivire. This power can't be used if Electivire is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Discharge
attacks.text: Discard all Lightning Energy attached to Electivire. Flip a coin for each Lightning Energy you discarded. This attack does 50 damage times the number of heads.

cards.flavorText: It pushes the tips of its two tails against the foe, then lets loose with over 20,000 volts of power.
cards.name: Electivire

abilities.name: Energy Shift
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if Electrode would be Knocked Out by damage from an attack, you may use this power. Electrode isn't discarded. Instead, attach it as an Energy card to 1 of your Pokémon. While attached, this card is a Special Energy card and provides every type of Energy but provides only 1 Energy at a time. (Has no effect other than providing Energy.)

attacks.name: Ion Blast
attacks.text: You may do 40 damage plus 60 more damage. If you do, Electrode does 100 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: It is known to drift on winds if it is bloated to bursting with stored electricity.
cards.name: Electrode

attacks.name: Keen Eye
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 cards and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Baton Pass
attacks.text: You may switch Furret with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. If you do, move as many Energy cards attached to Furret as you like to the new Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: The mother puts its offspring to sleep by curling up around them. It corners foes with speed.
cards.name: Furret

attacks.name: Encore
attacks.text: Choose 1 of the Defending Pokémon's attacks. That Pokémon can use only that attack during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Break Beam
attacks.text: You may do 40 damage plus 20 more damage. If you do, Golduck is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: A Pokémon that lives in lakes. It swims faster than any human swimming champion.
cards.name: Golduck

attacks.name: Double Throw
attacks.text: Choose 2 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 30 damage to each of them. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Megaton Rock
attacks.text: You may do 40 damage instead of 80 to the Defending Pokémon. If you do, during your opponent's next turn, any damage done to Golem by attacks is reduced by 40 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: It sheds its hide once a year. Its boulderlike body is so tough, even dynamite can't harm it.
cards.name: Golem

attacks.name: Icy Kiss
attacks.text: If Jynx was damaged by an attack during your opponent's last turn, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Lovely Kiss
attacks.text: Move 2 damage counters from Jynx to the Defending Pokémon. If Smoochum is anywhere under Jynx, move 4 damage counters instead.

cards.flavorText: It cries sound like human speech. However, it is impossible to tell what it is trying to say.
cards.name: Jynx

abilities.name: Flame Body
abilities.text: When you attach a Fire Energy card from your hand to Magmortar, remove 2 damage counters from Magmortar.

attacks.name: Flame Blast
attacks.text: Does 20 damage times the number of Fire Energy attached to Magmortar.

attacks.name: Fireball Bazooka
attacks.text: Does 20 damage to 2 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: It blasts fireballs of over 3,600 degrees F from the ends of its arms. It lives in volcanic craters.
cards.name: Magmortar

abilities.name: Minus Charge
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if any Pokémon were Knocked Out during your opponent's last turn, you may draw 2 cards. You can't use more than 1 Minus Charge Poké-Power each turn. This power can't be used if Minun is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Tag Play —
attacks.text: If you have Plusle on your Bench, you may move an Energy card attached to Minun to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It cheers on friends. If its friends are losing, its body lets off more and more sparks.
cards.name: Minun

attacks.name: Silver Wind
attacks.text: During your next turn, if an attack does damage to the Defending Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance), that attack does 40 more damage.

attacks.name: Raging Scales
attacks.text: If Mothim has any damage counters on it, this attack does 30 damage plus 40 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It loves the honey of flowers and steals honey collected by COMBEE.
cards.name: Mothim

attacks.name: Poison Rub
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned. Before doing damage, you may switch 1 of the Defending Pokémon with 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. The new Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

attacks.name: Pride Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin for each Nidoqueen on your Bench. This attack does 60 damage plus 30 more damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: One swing of its mighty tail can snap a telephone pole as if it were a matchstick.
cards.name: Nidoking

attacks.name: Mirror Move
attacks.text: If Pidgeot was damaged by an attack during your opponent's last turn, this attack does the same amount of damage done to Pidgeot to the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Whirlwind
attacks.text: Your opponent switches the Defending Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: By flapping its wings with all its might, PIDGEOT can make a gust of wind capable of bending tall trees.
cards.name: Pidgeot

abilities.name: Plus Charge
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out during your opponent's last turn, you may search your discard pile for up to 2 basic Energy cards, show them to your opponent, and put them into your hand. You can't use more than 1 Plus Charge Poké-Power each turn. This power can't be used if Plusle is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Tag Play +
attacks.text: If you have Minun on your Bench, you may do 20 damage to any 1 Benched Pokémon instead. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: It cheers on friends with pom-poms made of sparks. It drains power from telephone poles.

Bebe's Search
rules: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

Choose a card from your hand and put it on top of your deck. Search your deck for a Pokémon, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward. (If this is the only card in your hand, you can't play this card.)

cards.name: Night Maintenance
rules: Search your discard pile for up to 3 in any combination of Pokémon and basic Energy cards. Show them to your opponent and shuffle them into your deck.

cards.name: PlusPower
rules: Attach PlusPower to 1 of your Pokémon. Discard this card at the end of your turn.
If the Pokémon PlusPower is attached to attacks, the attack does 10 more damage to the Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.name: Professor Oak's Visit
rules: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.
Draw 3 cards. Then, choose a card from your hand and put it on the bottom of your deck.

cards.name: Professor Rowan
rules: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.
Choose 1 card in your hand and shuffle the rest of your cards into your deck. Then, draw 4 cards. (If this is the only card in your hand, you can't play this card.)

cards.name: Rival
rules: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.
Reveal the top 5 cards of your deck. Your opponent chooses 3 of those cards. Put those cards into your hand and put other 2 cards on top of your deck. Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.name: Roseanne's Research
rules: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.
Search your deck for up to 2 in any combination of Basic Pokémon and basic Energy cards, show them to your opponent, and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.name: Team Galactic's Mars
rules: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.
Draw 2 cards. Then, choose a card from your opponent's hand without looking and put it on the bottom of his or her deck.

cards.name: Potion
rules: Remove 2 damage counters from 1 of your Pokémon (remove 1 damage counter if that Pokémon has only 1).

cards.name: Switch
rules: Switch 1 of your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.name: Darkness Energy
rules: If the Pokémon Darkness Energy is attached to attacks, the attack does 10 more damage to the Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance). Ignore this effect if the Pokémon that Darkness Energy is attached to isn't Darkness. Darkness Energy provides Darkness Energy. (Doesn't count as a basic Energy card.)

cards.name: Metal Energy
rules: Damage done by attacks to the Pokémon that Metal Energy is attached to is reduced by 10 (after applying Weakness and Resistance). Ignore this effect if the Pokémon that Metal Energy is attached to isn't Metal. Metal Energy provides Metal Energy. (Doesn't count as a basic Energy card.)

rules: Play Old Amber as if it were a Colorless Basic Pokémon. (Old Amber counts as a Trainer card as well, but if Old Amber is Knocked Out, this counts as a Knocked Out Pokémon.) cards.name: Dome Fossil

Conductive Quarry
rules: This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. If another card with the same name is in play, you can't play this card.

Once during each player's turn, the player may flip a coin. If heads, that player searches his or her discard pile for a Lightning or Metal Energy card, shows it to the opponent, and puts it into his or her hand.

cards.name: Energy Link
rules: Attach Energy Link to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached to it. If that Pokémon is Knocked Out, discard this card.

As long as Energy Link is attached to a Pokémon, you may move an Energy card attached to that Pokémon to another of your Pokémon that has Energy Link attached to it. You may use this effect as often as you like during your turn.

cards.name: Energy Switch
rules: Move a basic Energy card attached to 1 of your Pokémon to another of your Pokémon.

cards.name: Great Ball
rules: Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon and put it onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.name: Luxury Ball
rules: Search your deck for a Pokémon (excluding Pokémon LV.X), show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward. If any Luxury Ball is in your discard pile, you can't play this card.

cards.name: Marley's Request
rules: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

Search your discard pile for 2 different Trainer, Supporter, or Stadium cards, show them to your opponent, and your opponent chooses 1 of them. Put that card into your hand, and discard the other card. (If all Trainer, Supporter, and Stadium cards in your discard pile have the same name, choose 1 of them. Show that card to your opponent and put it into your hand.)

cards.name: Poké Blower +
rules: You may play 2 Poké Blower + at the same time. If you play 1 Poké Blower +, flip a coin. If heads, put 1 damage counter on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. If you play 2 Poké Blower +, choose 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon and switch it with 1 of your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.name: Poké Drawer +
rules: You may play 2 Poké Drawer + at the same time. If you play 1 Poké Drawer +, draw a card. If you play 2 Poké Drawer +, search your deck for up to 2 cards, and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.name: Poké Healer +
rules: You may play 2 Poké Healer + at the same time. If you play 1 Poké Healer +, remove 1 damage counter and a Special Condition from 1 of your Active Pokémon. If you play 2 Poké Healer +, remove 8 damage counters and all Special Conditions from 1 of your Active Pokémon.

cards.name: Premier Ball
rules: Search your deck or your discard pile for a Pokémon LV.X, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. If you search your deck, shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.name: Potion
rules: Remove 2 damage counters from 1 of your Pokémon (remove 1 damage counter if that Pokémon has only 1).

cards.name: Switch
rules: Switch 1 of your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.name: Cyclone Energy
rules: Cyclone Energy provides Colorless Energy. When you attach this card from your hand to your Active Pokémon, switch 1 of the Defending Pokémon with 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. Your opponent chooses the Benched Pokémon to switch.

cards.name: Warp Energy
rules: Warp Energy provides Colorless Energy. When you attach this card from your hand to your Active Pokémon, switch that Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

abilities.name: Ectoplasm
abilities.text: If Dusknoir is your Active Pokémon and would be Knocked Out by damage from your opponent's attack, you may discard all cards attached to Dusknoir LV.X and put Dusknoir LV.X as a Stadium card into play instead of discarding it. This counts as Dusknoir being Knocked Out and your opponent takes a Prize card. As long as you have Dusknoir LV.X as a Stadium card in play, put 1 damage counter on each of your opponent's Pokémon between turns. If another Stadium card comes into play or Dusknoir LV.X is discarded by the effects of any attacks, Poké-Powers, Poké-Bodies, Trainer, or Supporter cards, return Dusknoir LV.X to your hand.
